title: Baguio mural traces Cordillera heritage, calls for cultural stewardship

blocks.text: BAGUIO CITY, Philippines —A mural depicting Cordillera’s ancestral traditions, cultural symbols, and Baguio’s familiar landmarks was unveiled at Venus Parkview Hotel along Kisad Road in this city on Saturday, Nov. 21, promoting the preservation of the region’s cultural identity. The mixed-media artwork, titled “Pinaing: Memory, Identity, and Living Traditions,” was described by local officials as a symbol of indigenous beliefs, traditional practices, and places that have become part of Baguio’s identity. Venus Parkview Hotel chief executive officer Isabelle Villanueva-Barter, in her opening remarks, recalled how Ibaloi families cared for the land before succeeding generations shaped the city.
